title: CanopyFormer: Attention-Guided SegFormer for Explainable Forest Cover Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In transformer segmentation models, attention is usually visualized after training rather than supervised. Although attention supervision has been explored for natural images and driving scenes, aerial forest segmentation typically uses attention only as an architectural component and evaluates interpretability qualitatively. We present CanopyFormer, an attention-guided SegFormer-B0 that uses an Attention Consistency Loss to align attention with the ground-truth forest mask, encouraging attention to focus on canopy regions. Since SegFormer uses spatial-reduction attention, we adapt Gradient-weighted Attention Rollout by restricting it to the final encoder stage, where the attention matrix is square. We introduce Average Attention-Mask Overlap (AAMO) to measure attention alignment and incorporate a deletion test to evaluate faithfulness. translated_title: CanopyFormer：注意力引导的SegFormer用于可解释的森林覆盖分割
translated_abstract: 在Transformer分割模型中，注意力通常是在训练之后才被可视化，而非受到监督。尽管注意力监督已在自然图像和驾驶场景中得到探索，但航空森林分割通常仅将注意力作为架构组件使用，并以定性方式评估可解释性。我们提出了CanopyFormer，这是一种注意力引导的SegFormer-B0模型，它使用注意力一致性损失将注意力与真实森林掩码对齐，促使注意力聚焦于树冠区域。由于SegFormer使用空间缩减注意力，我们通过将梯度加权注意力推演限制在最后一个编码器阶段（该阶段的注意力矩阵为方阵）来适配该方法。我们引入平均注意力掩码重叠度来衡量注意力对齐程度，并结合删除测试来评估忠实性。在5108张图像上，我们的方法将AAMO从0.0334提升至0.7476，约为原始模型的22倍。
tldr: CanopyFormer通过注意力一致性损失将SegFormer的注意力与真实森林掩码对齐，并引入AAMO指标和删除测试对森林覆盖分割中的注意力可解释性进行量化评估，使注意力对齐度提升约22倍。
en_tdlr: CanopyFormer aligns SegFormer's attention with ground-truth forest masks via an Attention Consistency Loss, and introduces AAMO and a deletion test to quantitatively evaluate attention explainability in forest cover segmentation, improving attention alignment by approximately 22 times.
